description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of sources cited in a study of narrative media framing in political discourse. The chart contains 16 slices, each representing a different news source. The slices are labeled as follows: Breitbart (14%), Other (13%), Shareblue (8%), NPR (8%), Drudge Report (8%), Vox (6%), The Guardian (5%), BBC (5%), RT (3%), Daily Kos (3%), National Review (3%), Daily RedState (3%), Fox News (3%), CNN (3%), PoliticusUSA (3%), and The Huffington Post (7%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained throughout. A legend is not present, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
